Package io.telekom.orchest.orchestrest.service

Class UserTaskAPIService

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.orchestrest.service.UserTaskAPIService
@Service public class UserTaskAPIService extends Object
Service layer for User Task REST API operations. Handles authorization checks, delegates to UserTaskService for lifecycle operations, and triggers process continuation via OrchestWorkflowEngine.resumeActivity(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, io.telekom.orchest.api.core.request.Variables).

    • completeTask

      public UserTaskDTO completeTask(String taskId, Map<String,Object> variables, LoggedInUserContext userContext)
      Completes a user task and continues the process execution.

      This method:

      1. Validates the user is authorized to complete the task
      2. Marks the task as COMPLETED in the user task store
      3. Calls resumeActivity() on the workflow engine to continue the process
      Parameters:
      taskId - The task ID to complete.
      variables - Output variables from the user task.
      Returns:
      The completed task DTO.
